sessions.phase_label: Paperback-cover corrections, platform adaptation, troubleshooting, and delivery

requirements.title: Preserve Existing Cover Design
requirements.definition: Preserve the finalized cover design except for the specifically requested text, typography, dimensional, and export corrections.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the independent no-redesign constraint; the permitted blurb, title-font, platform-dimension, and export corrections remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Back-Cover Blurb Reflow and Barcode Clearance
requirements.definition: Use the shortened final blurb and reflow it so the final paragraph does not overlap the back-cover barcode.
requirements.boundary_note: The wording reduction, paragraph reflow, and barcode clearance form one tightly coupled layout correction; title typography and platform spine dimensions are independently testable.

requirements.title: Cover Title Font Consistency
requirements.definition: Make the spine and back-cover title typography match the bold gold-gradient title typography used on the front cover.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers visual consistency of the title across cover panels, not font embedding, tagline rendering, blurb layout, or spine dimensions.

requirements.title: Portable Front-Tagline Rendering
requirements.definition: Ensure the front-cover tagline renders as the intended words across viewers and exports by embedding its font or outlining/converting the text to curves.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently failing export-rendering behavior, separate from visually matching the title fonts and from general platform upload acceptance.

requirements.title: Amazon Cover Specification
requirements.definition: Produce an Amazon-specific paperback cover using the applicable Amazon template, 420-page configuration, and 0.90-inch spine.
requirements.boundary_note: Amazon dimensions can be completed and accepted while the D2D version remains unresolved, so the two platform outputs are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: D2D Cover Specification
requirements.definition: Produce a separate D2D print cover using the confirmed D2D template, page configuration, and spine width rather than treating D2D/Ingram as the Amazon cover.
requirements.boundary_note: The D2D version has its own deferred and resumed dimensional decision, including the eventual 0.82-inch spine, and therefore must not be merged with the Amazon cover specification.

requirements.title: Final Cover Deliverable Formats
requirements.definition: Provide the completed cover assets as a layered PSD, PDF, and JPG.
requirements.boundary_note: The three formats are attributes of one delivery package; platform-specific dimensions, upload compatibility, and version identification are independently testable behaviors.

requirements.title: Amazon PDF Upload Compatibility
requirements.definition: Provide a print-quality PDF that Amazon KDP can process and upload successfully, with quality-preserving file-size optimization available when needed.
requirements.boundary_note: Upload processing can fail even when the cover dimensions and visual design are correct, so compatibility is separate from the Amazon cover specification and general format delivery.

requirements.title: Platform PDF Identification
requirements.definition: Make the Amazon 420-page PDF and D2D 428-page PDF distinguishable so the client can identify and use the correct platform-specific file.
requirements.boundary_note: File identification is independent of whether both PDFs exist and whether each platform accepts its PDF; it addresses selecting the correct version during delivery.

source_message.text:
Nathaniel, I wanted to check whether you’re available for a quick paperback-cover job.

• The cover needs 2 small fixes, limited to deleting a few words from my blurb and making the title font consistent across the front, spine, and back. Everything else is final, so no redesign is required.
• Please provide a layered .psd, a .pdf, and a .jpg.
• I need the completed files within 72 hours.

Would you be available? My budget is $90.

Best,
Marisol

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Nathaniel,

While I wait for D2D, I’ll post on its social media to see whether that gets a faster response. Separately, there is an issue with your cover:

• Both the blurb edit and the title-font correction look good and were completed properly.
• The tagline at the top of the front cover ("DEATH AT THE LANTERN FESTIVAL") is appearing as garbled, corrupted text rather than the intended words.
• Font substitution or an encoding problem may be responsible, so please check which font that text box uses.
• For the new export, either embed the fonts or outline/convert them to curves. This will prevent the text from depending on local font availability and ensure that it renders correctly everywhere.
• Please correct the problem and resend the .pdf before the other files.

Thx
